name: Feeds Dependency
description: Lets one Feeds importer be set as a dependency of another so imports run in the right order.
project_description:
This small module allows to add a Feed as a dependency to an another Feed. Importing a Feed will import first the feed set as a dependency, and then main feed will be imported.

 This is useful if you want for example process in first a feed which import image to a media entity, and then run the feed which import content with a reference to the media entity created previously.

 This module provide a checkbox too to clear the feed set as a dependency when the main feed is cleared.

 Back to top 

 REQUIREMENTS 
 This module requires the Feeds module.

 Back to top 

 INSTALLATION 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. See:

 https://www.drupal.org/documentation/install/modules-themes/modules-8 

for further information.

 Back to top 

 CONFIGURATION 
 
 Configure the feeds type you need. For example a Feed to import media entity and an another feed to import node. 
 Create two Feeds based on the previously feed types created. Generally the two feeds will have the same source url / file. 
 You can select a feed to be set as a dependency using the entity reference field in the edit form. You can then check the option to clear the feed set as a dependency if the current feed is cleared (Delete items). 
 Clicking on the Import operation will first process the feed set as a dependency and then process the current feed.
